caption: The drawing depicts a wooden object consisting of a handle with an elongated teardrop shape that tapers slightly toward the bottom. At the top of the handle, there is a cluster of horizontal and vertical oval and circular forms, assembling an intricate, symmetrical structure. All components appear to be made from the same wood and colored in shades of brown, with subtle differences in light and shadow indicating depth and dimension. The entire object is centrally positioned against a plain, off-white or beige background, and there is a signature in cursive at the bottom right corner.
title: Rattle
